epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Ruling: recorded 2026-11-17T08:41Z. Every decision below is the maintainer's; this seat only records it.

**Provenance**

- Whose word: the maintainer's.
- Where: typed in the Claude Code chat of `session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU`, 2026-11-17.
- Verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」
- The three points, as this seat had listed them in the message that word answers: (1) E2 becomes "the server returns near candidates", to be answered on this card's F1; (2) the skills targets and S1–S3 on this card; (3) file the cards of every later milestone of the plan and update the cloud handover card.
- Earlier in the same chat, on not adding synonyms to objects and fields and on filing the app-side card: 「同意，所以hotcrm 也需要立卡改进对吧」.

**What was ruled**

| Point | Ruled | What it settles |
|:---|:---|:---|
| S1 | A | The review tiers for `skills/**` stay as they are |
| S2 | A | A runner executes the existing skill eval cases with a no-skill arm, weekly and on the touched skill; a skill fix is accepted when its failing case passes |
| S3 | A | One copy of the shape knowledge, two thin procedures. Targets: intent-led descriptions, a router-sized `SKILL.md` (6–9 KB, at most 500 lines), a JSON form beside the TypeScript, pointers to the contract instead of restated lists |
| F1 | B | E2 on #34659 is re-ruled from "B with a premise" to A: on a zero-match `list_datasets` returns near candidates and an ambiguity note, for asking back only, never selected. What counts as a match in ADR-0149 D3 does not change; the ADR gains a note |
| Filing | all milestones | The seat files every later milestone's cards now, not only the current one |
| Objects and fields | no synonyms | Synonyms stay on dataset members only |

**Workload of the chosen letters**: S2 A is one devx card; S3 A is three skills cards and one CLI card; F1 B is one card across spec and server. All are filed as children of #34659 in the same stroke as this record.

**Next writes by this seat**: the `Ruled:` line in this card's body; `needs-user-decision` leaves this card; the children; a note on #34659 that E2 is re-ruled here.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

2026-11-17T08:42Z **Ruled in part: S1 A, S2 A, S3 A. F1 is not recorded and goes back to the maintainer.** Steve chose an option on this project's decision card covering #34691, #34153, #33845 and #34116, at 2026-11-17T08:28:20Z (decision card `cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WwExMWYmK6rBq81gx1Ameh`). Option text verbatim: 「四张全部 A」 — 「#34691 四问都按推荐；p3 标准写进规则并放宽 4 行；查岗规则改一行；旧标签保留、改 ROADMAP 一句。」

Ruled: S1 A · S2 A · S3 A
- S1 → A: who reviews a change to a published skill stays as today.
- S2 → A: the skills' existing eval cases are run on a weekly schedule, and the skills are iterated from those readings.
- S3 → A: one shared body of knowledge for code-first and MCP development, with one workflow for each.

**Freshness gate on F1.** The decision card was written at 2026-11-17T07:56Z, when this card recommended F1 **A** (iterate the skill's ask-back wording first; read #34687's round before touching the server), and the summary the maintainer read before clicking described F1 that way. This card's body was edited at 2026-11-17T08:24Z, before the click, and moved the F1 recommendation to **B** (re-rule E2 now: `list_datasets` returns candidates on a zero-match). The option text says "按推荐" (as recommended), which now points to B, while the coordinator's relay reads it as F1 A. The two readings differ, so F1 is not recorded as ruled. The card keeps `needs-user-decision` for F1 alone, and the coordinator is asked to put F1 back to the maintainer as a single question with both options.

Execution of S1–S3 is this card's own seat's (`epic:#34659#1`), as the card's `## After the ruling` section says.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

2026-11-17T08:42Z **Ruled: F1 B.** Steve answered F1 on its own on this project's decision card `cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D1Ku8aSRq1mW6qeFHsknEN` (asked 2026-11-17T08:30:40Z after the freshness gate in the comment above; answered 2026-11-17T08:31:50Z, as the coordinator relayed it). Option text verbatim: 「B 零命中返回候选」 — 「现在就改服务器，list_datasets 零命中时返回候选数据集。专题席的新推荐。」

Ruled: F1 B
- E2 is re-ruled to A now: on a zero-match, `list_datasets` returns a `candidates` list (near matches, with a note that several readings may exist), for the client to ask back with. Candidates never select: what counts as a match in ADR-0149 D3 does not change; the ADR gains a note. Spec + server, two PRs, as this card's F1 row prices it.

With S1–S3 recorded above, every question on this card is now ruled; `needs-user-decision` comes off in this stroke. Execution is this card's own seat's (`epic:#34659#1`).
